sources.name: Oct 2025 I-485 report + Dec 2025 Visa Bulletin

unreserved.note: China FAD Jul 14 2016 (Dec 2025 VB), India FAD Jul 1 2021 (Jan 2026 VB)

rural.note: No set-aside cutoff as of Sept 2026; Lazicki expects Rural to retrogress soon due to qualified volume vs DOS lag

hua.note: Current but 6.9x ROW excess set-aside-only; Lazicki surprised if HUA gets dates in FY26

infra.note: Current but >400 investors recruited by end 2025 per Mar 6 revision; supply only 400 first yr / 200 thereafter

datesForFiling.note: When Current, concurrent I-485/I-765 filing allowed → EAD possible

pipeline.note: Apr 2022-Jun 2026 receipts 19,780 per Sept 9 post; estimated pending visa applicants with family (2x multiplier)
pipeline.assumption: 2 visas per I-526/I-526E after denials/family; see Mar 5 post Summary2 tab

supply.note: Typical EB-5 10k/yr; RIA set-aside 32% (20% Rural, 10% HUA, 2% Infra)

i526e.note: Q2 median 11.7mo (770 approved); total IPO ~1930 decisions Q3 vs 4060 FY24Q2

i485.dosLag: Johannesburg Aug 2023 DQ still scheduling Aug 2026; I-485 EB-5 use 405 Oct25/May26, 105 Jun26, 152 Jul26

processing.notFIFO: I-526E processing order not strictly FIFO; see https://blog.lucidtext.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/processing-trend.jpg

i485Inventory.note: Visual estimate from Sept 9 stacked chart; precise requires USCIS Pending EB Apps

projections.method: Lazicki backlog model: compare pipeline visas vs annual category visas; per-country 7.1% cap when retrogressed

setAsideOnly.note: If every investor must take set-aside visa of same category

hua.row: 6.9x excess even if ROW gets all HUA visas → 6+ yr

infra.india: 0 to multi-deque depending on flurry sort
infra.china: 0 to multi-deque depending on flurry sort

withUnreservedOverflow.note: If set-aside investors can claim Unreserved in priority-date/country order (DOS consular process exists, USCIS AOS not yet)
withUnreservedOverflow.clearing: 2033 (~7yr from 2026) for all 2026 priority dates per Lazicki optimistic model (low confidence)
withUnreservedOverflow.perCountryTotalYears: ~7-8yr for China/India regardless of category; ROW slightly better
withUnreservedOverflow.market3to5yr: vanishingly improbable for India/China Rural/HUA even with overflow

caveats: Excel Summary2/Infra tabs not OCR'd, formulas image-only
FY26 visa limits unpublished (DOS silence May 2025), 400/200 Infra inferred
2.0x family multiplier vs 2.8 swings years significantly
Visa Bulletin Current = few qualified (~687/Q3) + slow DOS, not no backlog
